**1. Global Risk Regime?**

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral overall: SPY/TLT balance shows SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION → flat, keeping financial conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; Tech ETF XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND but sector-level tech breadth weak, so Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
EM strength vs the US: EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND while SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND — China RECOVERY: FXI (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.19%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation healthy: IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.85%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; small caps IWM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Oil & commodities leadership: USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; Gold GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy clear tailwind: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed: Equities (SPY 1W/1M both positive) and Energy (XLE both positive). Divergences: multiple 1W vs 1M CORRECTIONs (GLD, SLV, WEAT) and narrow sector breadth (4/11) — MINOR divergence overall.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor energy/commodity exposure (XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor speculative flows (IBIT, ARKK); reduce exposure to weak cyclicals like XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND and XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, bonds neutral (TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND; Financials monitor via breadth (Financials 1W: +0.43% | 1M: -0.22%).  
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary — XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND; Industrials — XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Oil — USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Gold consolidation — GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX complacency level (VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling) to watch for renewed risk-on; HYG/LQD balance (HYG 1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41% BELOW TREND) for credit stress; XLK pivot vs cyclicals (XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling and flat credit (HYG/LQD). Energy and commodities (XLE 1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%; USO 1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) showing strength while narrow breadth and multiple 1W/1M CORRECTIONs are the main divergence to monitor.
